intro: Become a Yoga Alliance certified Yin yoga teacher with our comprehensive 100 Hour Yin Yoga Teacher Training in Canggu Bali. Whether it is for recreation or as a sportsman who wants to enhance flexibility and reduce incidences of injury, Yin Yoga is here to revolutionize your life.
Unlike most other forms of yoga that are practiced today, Yin Yoga takes the initiative on a slow journey, deep into the tissues of the body such as the ligaments, fascia and tendons.

Life is filled with stress— from heavy training sessions, long office days or hours on your feet. Applying Yin Yoga is a great boon especially for those areas that tend to be tighter such as hip region, chest, lower back and legs.

The biggest difference of Yin Yoga is that it primarily targets the connective tissues. Such items as bolsters, blocks and blankets are employed to make sure that the practice is free from injuries. Based on TCM principles and yoga tradition, this training will provide you with all the necessary knowledge and practice to share Yin Yoga with others or deepen your own practice.

dining.text: We serve plant-based meals, prepared with the highest standards of hygiene, cleanliness, and love to support your yoga journey. One of the primary practices in yoga is ahimsa, meaning non-violence. By following a plant-based diet during your training, you are in the practice of ahimsa.
mealTimes: Lunch & Dinner are not served on Sundays.

arrival: In order for you to rest properly before the opening ceremony on the 1st day of the course, the check-in to the school should be one day before the course begins. Your check-in time must be between 10 AM to 4 PM. We provide you a complimentary stay for that night. Your check-out on the last day of the course must be between 12 PM to 2 PM.

policies.title: Important Points

policies.title: Booking
items: Advance booking fee: In order to book the course, you are required to deposit the booking fee. We accept the booking fee via Razorpay | Western Union | bank transfer or TransferWise. An official booking confirmation letter will be sent to you shortly after successful advance deposit; the balance of the course fees can be paid on arrival at school either by credit card, debit card or cash.
